items: 【Smart APP Control · Easy & Efficient】Tired of complicated laser measures that take time to learn? With full APP integration, this laser measuring tool makes measuring smarter and easier. Sync data instantly to your phone, create groups, add annotated photos, and draw sketches. Effortlessly switch units, modes, and reference points in real time. Simple to operate, perfect for both beginners and professionals

【Brighter Green Laser & High Accuracy】Equipped with advanced green beam laser technology, 4X brighter than standard red lasers for superior visibility even in bright environments, and softer on the eyes. Delivers up to ±1/16-inch accuracy, more precise than most laser tape measures. Laser class: Class 2, 490–560nm, <1mW

​【2-Year Quality Ensured】This laser measuring tool enjoys 2-year quality ensured. Free repair or replacement is provided if the product is faulty. Huepar is committed to provide Best-in-Class service to our customers- 24/7 Service Team（response in 24hrs & solution in 48hrs). Lifetime Technical Support, Worldwide Maintenance Center ( your product can be repaired or replaced faster )

【3 Power Options & Smart Energy Saving】Comes with 2 rechargeable 1200mAh NiMH batteries for long-lasting use, USB-C direct charging, and also compatible with AA batteries. Auto shut-off after 180s of no operation saves power efficiently

【Durable & User-Friendly Design】Measure from front/middle/rear reference points; 1/4" threaded mount allows tripod use for stable measurements. IP54 dust- & water-resistant design with TPE rubberized housing provides a secure grip, scratch resistance, and durability

【Real-Time Angle Sensor & Large Backlit Display】Built-in digital angle sensor with ±1° accuracy ensures improved measurement precision. The 2-inch backlit LCD screen provides clear, easy-to-read data—ideal for home projects, garden fences, construction sites, and professional applications

【Multiple Measurement Modes & Unit Switch】Supports distance, angle, area, volume, and 4 Pythagorean modes. Features continuous measurement, addition & subtraction, automatic area/volume calculation, and stores up to 30 groups of data. Switchable units (m/ft/in/ft+in) meet diverse measurement needs
